articles.title: ‘I wanted to help another family’: four surrogates on how they feel about the surrogacy discourse
articles.description:
The Guardian spoke with surrogates across the US about what they think of the controversy surrounding the practice

Surrogacy has been thrust into the national spotlight in recent weeks, with both the announcement of Lena Dunham using a surrogate to start a family and the ongoing legal battle surrounding McKenna West, a gestational surrogate who fled to Texas to avoid having an abortion that was requested by the child’s biological parents.

With a renewed public interest on commercial, or compensated, surrogacy, the Guardian spoke with surrogates across the US who shared their experiences and how they feel about surrogacy being part of a global, public conversation.

articles.title: Gus Lamont’s parents make emotional plea as $1m reward offered for information about disappearance
articles.description:
No trace of Gus has been found since he went missing from his family’s South Australian farm on 27 September last year

The parents of missing four-year-old Gus Lamont have made an emotional plea for any information about their “unique little boy” as authorities offered a $1m reward over the disappearance.

No trace of Gus has been found since he went missing from his family’s enormous sheep farm in the South Australian outback almost a year ago.
